website_status_detail: Not 'never had one' — lapsed. A template site lived at canaanhealthproviders.org from 2017 to 2021, degenerated into a bare redirect to facebook.com by Feb 2025, and the domain has since dropped out of the registry. The email on their Minet panel and Yellow Pages listing therefore bounces. No replacement site and no social page exist.

score.confidence: medium-high on website/contacts; medium on health; low on pay

factors.name: health
factors.reason: Continuously contracted — Teachers 2023, UAP Old Mutual 2024, Minet 2025 — and listed since 2011. Capped at 6 by only 4 reviews and no social activity.

factors.name: readiness
factors.reason: No site, no socials, dead email; phone lines only. The pipeline's formula returns 5 solely because `whatsapp` is populated, and that value is a copy of `phone`.

factors.name: need
factors.reason: Lapsed branded domain, dead published email and an abandoned template site — total absence, not a weak site.

factors.name: pay
factors.reason: Bills three insurer panels, so revenue is institutional; single branch, no published size.

factors.name: reach
factors.reason: A mobile and three landlines published consistently across panels and directories, but no named person and WhatsApp unverified.

factors.name: assets
factors.reason: Nothing exists to reuse — no logo, photos or brand colours.

recommendation_reason: Real clinic, on three insurer panels across 2023-2025, reachable by mobile, and its web presence is dead rather than absent: a half-built template site, a facebook.com redirect, and a domain that has since lapsed. Not a false 'no site' claim like Vital Ray. Held to tier B by having no assets and no named contact. Contact by phone/WhatsApp only — the published email cannot receive mail.
